mainEntity.name: What kind of paint is best for interior walls?

acceptedAnswer.text: For interior walls, latex (water-based) paints are commonly recommended due to their ease of application, quick drying time, and simple cleanup. Within latex options, you can choose different sheens: flat for hiding imperfections, eggshell or satin for durability and easy cleaning in living areas, and semi-gloss or high-gloss for high-traffic areas like kitchens, bathrooms, and trim due to their superior scrubbability. The 'best' paint depends on the specific room's use and desired finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Latex paints are generally best for interior walls, with sheens like flat, eggshell, or satin being popular choices depending on the room's function and desired durability.
